name: notify
description: Notification inbox + native OS notifications when a long turn ends, a subagent or background task finishes, or Claude is stuck waiting for your approval.

minSeconds.title: Notify after (seconds)
minSeconds.description: Only notify for turns that ran at least this long.

osNotify.title: Native OS notifications
osNotify.description: Also send a desktop notification (Windows balloon, macOS Notification Center, Linux notify-send).

approvalWaitSeconds.title: Ping when an approval waits (seconds)
approvalWaitSeconds.description: Notify when a tool call has waited this long for your approval (-1 turns it off).
